title: Verify Service Advisor cannot delete a parts return
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Advisor role. (deleting a return requires Invoicing & Payments: Delete per spec v33; this role has Invoicing = View/Create and Edit, NO Delete).
Note: the role may display as 'Junior Service Advisor' in the build (the spec calls it 'Service Advisor').
At least one parts return record exists under Parts > Returns.
steps:
1. Click Parts, open Returns, and open a return record.
2. Look for a Delete option; if present, click it.
expected: Deleting the return is BLOCKED: the Delete Return control is absent or disabled, or clicking it returns a permission error.
